name: stale_aggregate
description: In main.go, `updateLineitem` updates detail rows in `lineitem` (`l_extendedprice`, `l_discount`, `l_tax`) but never recomputes or updates the parent `orders.o_totalprice`. The read endpoint `getOrder` then serves `o_totalprice` directly from `orders`, so after a line item change it can return a stale aggregate instead of the current sum derived from `lineitem`.
